corrections.text: The article states that private accounts and accounts belonging to users under 18 'were automatically excluded, according to TechCrunch.' The cited TechCrunch article does not address age or private-account handling. The Hacker News source cited elsewhere in the article describes a more nuanced policy: public accounts belonging to users under 18 are not automatically excluded from the feature -- only followers of that account could reuse the media, and only if the account's settings allowed reuse.

The article states Muse Image 'ships with more than 30 suggested presets, ... per the same announcement.' Meta's announcement applies the 'more than 30' figure to a different feature -- new AI-powered effects for Instagram Stories -- not to the presets panel, which is described without a stated count.
